text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common and serious side effects because it works by helping your kidneys remove excess sugar and fluid through your urine.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include burning, urgency, frequency, and cloudy or bloody urine.
Genital yeast infections: Common in both women (thick white discharge, itching, burning, pain) and men (redness, itching, swelling, or pain around the penis).
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom to pee more often.
Mild effects: Increased thirst, joint pain, nausea, weight loss, or slightly raised cholesterol.
Dehydration: Loss of body water and salt, causing dizziness, lightheadedness, or feeling faint (especially when standing up).

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid in the blood—even if blood sugar is not very high—with symptoms like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, fruity breath, and trouble breathing.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if taken with other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Serious genital or urinary infections: Including severe kidney infections (pyelonephritis) or a rare, life-threatening necrotizing infection of the perineum called Fournier's gangrene.
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk reported with SGLT2 inhibitors, particularly for people with a history of foot ulcers or peripheral vascular disease.
Severe allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, or throat, hives, or trouble breathing.

text_blocks.snippet: You can review full safety details through the Boehringer Ingelheim Jardiance Resource Page or consult the Mayo Clinic Empagliflozin Guide.
